fields.title: Stock dimensions and face gauges
fields.finding: The .6096 by 1.8288 m stock envelope is only published for gauges >=1.4986 mm; it is projected for thinner R10/R15 minima and the QS threshold. Formal gamma-plus-strength flotation at 103.892 m needs 8.235 mm faces, exceeding the 6.35 mm sheet maximum; even compression alone limits that stock to R<=99.898 m.
fields.next_evidence: Obtain gauge-specific stock dimensions, tolerances, forming and scarf-machining feasibility. The formal oversized result is not an available-stock design.
fields.check_disposition: Retained physical/model limitation. Arithmetic reproduction does not establish an installed-hull allowable.
